original_target.title: Finite homotopy models for spherical Čech complexes

scope_comparison: Conjecture 8.4 in current v2 is exactly the finite CW homotopy type assertion at every positive open-ball scale. Corollary 3.2 in 2512.23108 proves equivalence with a thickening, not a finite model or compactness of the entire thickening. Finite hypercube Cech complexes are different spaces.

primary_sources.locator: Conjecture 8.4 and following paragraphs; current v2, 12 April 2026
